metadata.title: Network Third-Party Connectivity

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability enabling controlled, auditable network connectivity with external third parties such as vendors, partners, and service providers.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Third-party access gateways, partner connectivity platforms, and inter-organization network integration services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Explicit, contract-bound third-party network connectivity with no implicit trust.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Third-party connectivity definitions, access scopes, session metadata, and audit records.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Third-party network access is explicitly authorized and continuously evaluated without implicit trust.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Identity-aware, policy-driven enforcement governs third-party network connectivity.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Third-party and contractor remote access aligns with SP 800-46 guidance, modernized through Zero Trust Architecture.

metadata.remarks: Network Third-Party Connectivity defines how external organizations are granted network access in a controlled, limited, and auditable manner. This pattern assumes no inherent trust in third-party networks or personnel and requires explicit scoping, mediation, and continuous oversight. It does not define identity proofing, authorization policy, or resiliency behaviors, which are handled by complementary Secure Identity and Secure Network patterns.

components.title: Third-Party Admission
components.description: Controlled admission of third-party connections into the institutional network.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid partner or contractor credentials to gain unauthorized network access.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Admission of third-party connections only after explicit identity and context evaluation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Restrict and explicitly authorize external information system connections.

components.title: Third-Party Scope Restriction
components.description: Limitation of third-party network access to explicitly approved systems and services.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Lateral movement by third-party access beyond authorized scope.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Segmentation constrains third-party connectivity to approved zones.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Enforce least-privilege access to network resources.

components.title: Third-Party Session Monitoring
components.description: Observation and logging of third-party network activity for detection and accountability.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of permitted application-layer protocols during third-party sessions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Continuous analysis of third-party traffic supports timely detection of misuse.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Generate audit records for third-party access activity.
